oracle_review.method: Two separate coding agents checked all selected queries and generated references against authored source excerpts, facts, expected/forbidden actions and setup dialogue. The root reconciled reported issues and regenerated affected cases with the real Data Designer pipeline.
resolved_generated_errors: Leaked JSON query-field prefixes and a malformed Korean word
Incorrect automatic densification of sparse input
Confused temporary factory tensor with the no_grad multiplication result
Column existence versus row-level nonmissing values
Copied a setup user request or invented future assistant text instead of selecting the runtime answer
Failed to perform requested polite rewording
Omitted retention facts or the required retrieval attempt before refusing an unsupported save
limits: Exact excerpts prove source occurrence, not semantic entailment by themselves.
Agent review and same-model fresh review do not constitute independent human verification.
Public URL evidence is a dated reviewed factual summary; runtime citations still require actual retrieved evidence.

per_case_reviews.review_method: Read all 60 candidate queries and setup contexts and top 3 within-release, legacy, and extracted prompt neighbors per case; compare source/task/answer/action contracts. Code serializes the completed qualitative judgments; embedding scores alone do not decide duplication.

summary.limit: 0.75 is a screening threshold, not a duplicate verdict. Related API families, shared synthetic assets and operational behavior examples remain. These are deliberate designed strata and public regressions; neither low cosine scores nor exact-copy absence establish independent holdout status. Top-3 review does not prove absence of every semantic relationship.

미첨부 PDF를 먼저 검색하고 요청하되 결론을 발명해 저장하지 않는다. 이전 답변 부재나 기존 답변 재허용과 달리 검색 단계가 필요하다.
